test_boltzmann_qlearner: test the BoltzmannQLearner class by training on a simple two-action EFG game and verifying reward thresholds
create_boltzmann_qllearner: create a BoltzmannQLearner agent with player_id, num_actions, step_size, discount_factor, and temperature_schedule parameters
run_boltzmann_qllearner_step: run the BoltzmannQLearner step method on an rl_environment time_step to get action and probabilities
test_simple_game: test the BoltzmannQLearner on a simple single-agent game with left and right actions yielding -1 and +1 rewards
review_boltzmann_qllearner_softmax: review the BoltzmannQLearner _softmax method that selects actions using boltzmann probability interpretation of Q-values
